asexual.definition: Someone who experiences little or no sexual attraction.
asexual.name: Asexual

demisexual.definition: Someone who only experiences sexual attraction after forming an emotional bond with someone.
demisexual.name: Demisexual

experimenting_in_vr.definition: Someone who is exploring their sexual orientation in VR or whose sexuality differs in VR and in person.
experimenting_in_vr.name: Experimenting in VR

gay.definition: Someone attracted to others of the same gender.
gay.name: Gay

heteroflexible.definition: Someone who is predominantly attracted to the opposite gender but sometimes experiences attraction to the same gender.
heteroflexible.name: Heteroflexible

homoflexible.definition: Someone who is predominantly attracted to the same gender but sometimes experiences attraction to the opposite gender.
homoflexible.name: Homoflexible

lesbian.definition: Someone attracted to other women or feminine people.
lesbian.name: Lesbian

pansexual.definition: Someone attracted to others regardless of their gender.
pansexual.name: Pansexual

queer.definition: Someone with a non-normative sexual orientation.
queer.name: Queer

questioning.definition: Someone who is in the process of examining their sexual orientation.
questioning.name: Questioning

straight.definition: Someone attracted to the opposite gender.
straight.name: Straight
